name: Caption Designer Skill
purpose: Pick a caption preset from the film's style system and place captions by section (hook, body, outro, busy lower third) in portrait, landscape and square.
capabilities: Style system to caption preset and font mapping
Lane and size rules per section and format

compatibility.notes: Instructional skill over specs/caption-presets.json, src/pipeline/caption_style.py and Studio.comp.captions. Snapshot-checked with HyperFrames 0.8.226 on the M2 host; no full build yet.

licensing.notes: Workspace-authored. Ideas (not code) adopted from heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0) and josiahsiegel/claude-plugin-marketplace (MIT); see specs/caption-presets.json sources.

approval_evidence: Not yet approved: five presets and the lane positions were checked as HyperFrames snapshots of a scratch project on 2026-11-07, not in a full studio.py build or on a phone.
